notes.title: Speedrun Update
notes.notes: Dear speed runners, we've patched all of your sneaky tricks. But we have a new challenge for you, whoever has the fastest start to finish speed run time by this Thursday will have their name permanently immortalized on a plaque in the main lobby of Finding Frankie. ALL submissions must be recorded and posted to Youtube with a timer or external one visible. The timer begins when loaded into the game, and ends when the title card appears. You MUST use the latest build and include "Speedrun" in the video title. Happy running!

notes.title: Release Date Trailer Released!
notes.notes: Hey everyone! We are pleased to announce the final trailer for Finding Frankie has been released! With the trailer came it's official release date of October 25th 2024! We hope you all enjoy the trailer and wishlist the game to be notified when it drops October 25th![previewyoutube=jnQow-0nvlg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
